title: Philly Cheesesteaks
description: Thinly sliced beef seared on a hot skillet with onions and peppers, melted with provolone and piled into toasted rolls.

image.alt: A cheesesteak sandwich filled with sliced beef, onions and melted cheese

steps.text: Freeze the beef for {time 20 min notimer} so it slices paper-thin, then slice it and chop it roughly.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in the skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion and pepper with a pinch of the salt until soft and golden, {time 8-10 min}. Push them to one side.
Turn the heat to high, add the rest of the oil and the beef in a thin layer, and season with the salt and pepper. Cook, chopping and turning with a spatula, until just browned, {time 2-3 min}.
Mix in the onions and divide into {count 4} piles the size of your rolls. Lay 2 slices of cheese over each and let them melt, {time 1 min}.
Lay an open roll over each pile, slide the spatula underneath and flip everything into the roll. Serve hot.

notes: Some shops sell pre-sliced beef for cheesesteaks or hot pot, which saves the slicing step.
